card.name: Separators inside lists of items
card.fires_on: Commas, periods and spaces that separate items in a list, especially after a name or number and before the next one. Seen in lists of decimal values, author names, and healthcare-team members.

modes.label: Number lists
modes.description: Space or period between repeated decimal values in a run of numbers.

modes.label: Name or role lists
modes.description: Comma after an item in a list of authors or team members.
modes.example: Authors on the paper are Karhadkar<<,>> Bova, Nadia Abdallah,

card.plain: It fires on the separators between items in a list, such as commas between names or spaces between numbers.
